name: Cummy Bender
source: Korra has found herself in a whole heap of debt. Luckily, you, her new manager, have a few ideas on how to get her out of it. Lead Korra out of debt and onto the path of corruption by pressuring her to take riskier and riskier jobs to earn cash quickly.
